description: Add CANCELLATIONREASON_ID and CANCELLATIONDECIDEDBY_ID to PATIENTENCOUNTER if missing
author: Dr M H B Ariyaratne
preRequisites: Run migration.sql by hand on the database BEFORE deploying a build that maps PatientEncounter.cancellationReason and cancellationDecidedBy. The migration page only gets this file in that same build, so it cannot run this step first.
Without these columns every admission load fails.
Idempotent; changes no data. The reason list reuses the existing CATEGORY table and needs no change.
rollbackNotes: rollback.sql drops CANCELLATIONDECIDEDBY_ID and CANCELLATIONREASON_ID, then deletes the reason rows (CATEGORY rows with DTYPE = AdmissionCancellationReason). Recorded reasons and decision makers are lost.
